findings.text: When the captured stack has fewer than three lines, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` becomes '' and `String(err.stack).endsWith('')` is always true. The original regex left the stack unchanged when it didn't match, so the stack was still appended. Now the async call-site stack is silently dropped. Example: a short stack such as 'at a\nat b' with an existing err.stack.
